cards.title: The Protégé Problem
cards.instruction: Treat another player as someone you trained. Offer corrections, backhanded praise, and reminders of your influence.

cards.title: Make Help Define Us
cards.instruction: Get their help, then use how it is offered to redefine what the relationship means.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's use what I taught you. Help me write the complaint as a colleague, not my parent.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I was only correcting your spelling.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You're nearly doing it my way. Then leave the angry sentence. That's my contribution.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Good. Put both our names under it, not 'on behalf of.'
